hostFleetLru.result: Shared resident_multi_session Fleet; same-Host warm, native A/B/A, concurrent distinct Hosts and Sessions, exact switch-back, Core crash recovery, production idle eviction with exact resume, and planned shutdown process cleanup.

nativeSessionContinuation.result: Exact warm and Core cold resume; compacted Session restoration; no history Action or Approval replay; one invalid persisted identity produces one continuity-lost event and one replacement Session.

bootstrapContext.result: Official systemPrompt section and one-pass variable expansion read exact Session-bound SHA-256-verified private Bootstrap bytes at each model step; A/B/A, cold and compact retain the correct identity.

compactionContinuity.result: Native manual, pressure, context-overflow, automatic threshold and one controlled overflow plus real automatic retry; cancelled and failed compactions do not advance generation; fresh Skill and actual MCP capability checks remain available at each checkpoint.

skills.result: Real native .dsh/skills discovery and invocation; managed import, update, delete, disable, restart and same-name project conflict behavior; cli-operations attention path verified.

externalMcp.result: Whole-definition RovaiWins projection, Host update and fencing, exact Session resume, adjacent isolation, unassign, reassign, delete and native restoration passed through real DSH/Core MCP lifecycle; deterministic model fixture produced three native effects and zero Core-synthesized approvals.

toolActionCommandOutput.result: Real stdout, stderr, mixed, empty, nonzero and oversized output; canonical read/add/edit/empty-edit paths; byte-exact file contents and stable call identity. Add projects +1/-0, edit +1/-1 and empty-file edit +1/-0 through the shared Diff model.

narrationFinalMissingSend.result: Committed ACP public/thought distinction and authoritative end_turn; real zero-send recovery publication, accepted-send suppression and tool-to-final cases.

permissionApprovalWorkspace.result: Frozen sandbox and approval values; real workspace-write file and Bash inside the workspace succeed, outside writes fail, read-only writes and Bash fail, and cancelled Shell produces no delayed file after 32 seconds.

builtinRovaiCli.result: Current contract-v25 all 22 operations, 70 evidence rows and 35 output samples through native Bash and bundled CLI; three input sources, A2A, Gather, history and attachments, initial and successor Run lease fencing, and original Session continuation.

usageCacheCost.result: Independent native observer and Core database agree on every available token bucket and per-Run total across warm and cold continuation, including one automatic summary; exact cold resume has no replay. Unreported cache-write, reasoning and cost remain unknown.

retryQueueCancelCleanup.result: Shared accepted-input, queue and lease ownership; native overflow owns its retry; cancelled and failed operations do not produce late effects; Core crash, idle eviction and planned shutdown reap observed descendants.

readyVersionPlatform.result: CLI minimum >=0.1.5-rc.2 is separate from ACP bridge 0.0.1; executable fingerprint, initialize, new, exact resume and real grouped catalog are verified on GNU x86_64. This artifact does not qualify another architecture, libc family or operating-system platform key.

rerunNotes.builtinCli: The first final-report rerun completed both Gather deliveries and the completion Run but produced no captured-return marker, so the strict assertion failed. An unchanged rerun passed all 22 operations, the captured-return assertion, both lease fences and Native Session continuation. The earlier full acceptance run had also passed; no assertion was relaxed.

limitations: The deterministic model used by the MCP lifecycle smoke is protocol evidence and not provider-generation qualification; all other stated real-provider cases use MiniMax-M3 through native DSH.
ACP has no session/load, additionalDirectories, manual compact command, compaction lifecycle, MCP SSE/resources/prompts or client filesystem/terminal bridge.

The controlled overflow case injects one context-window error at the official stream seam and then exercises the real native summarizer and automatic retry; it does not claim natural provider-window exhaustion.

Ubuntu 24.04.5 target-host evidence qualifies the product's linux-x64 platform key only; it does not qualify Linux ARM64, musl, macOS x64 or Windows x64, and does not replace the separate Linux Server release ABI matrix.
Credentials, raw prompts, private paths, Native Session IDs, Run IDs and full tool output are excluded.

qualificationBasis.decision: All 14 Runtime integration axes are independently verified on GNU Linux x86_64. This is Adapter behavior qualification, separate from Server OS and packaged release qualification.
